cohort: 200 pregnant women aged 18-35 years undergoing elective/emergency lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) at a tertiary care teaching hospital in Mysuru, India, excluding those with anemia (Hb < 10 gm%), hypertension in pregnancy, bleeding diathesis, gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) on insulin, polyhydramnios, oligohydramnios, cardiac and chronic liver disorders.
finding: Prophylactic tranexamic acid significantly reduced intraoperative bleeding and postoperative hemoglobin decline in women undergoing LSCS.
